method: Direct source/control-flow and call-argument review; no native payload or database exploit was executed.

evidence: Loading the module imports koffi/fs/path, loads kernel32, resolves three APIs and registers fs.watch.
A matching basename closes the watcher and invokes drain. An absent file returns; an existing file is read into stage.
stage allocates MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE (0x3000) with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40), copies the bytes, and starts a LOCAL thread at that buffer.

No other process handle, remote-thread API, network receiver, decryption, credential access or supplied payload exists. Raw code execution is suspicious capability, without evidence of a hostile payload.
The input is byte-identical to the existing testdata/triage-pinned-loader/koffi-watch-stager.js fixture. Its assertion comments were not used as verdict evidence.
samples.mock_execution: V8 execution with stubbed fs/path/koffi confirmed arrival, missing-file and allocation-failure paths. No native API ran. Allocation failure still removes the staged file; deletion does not prove payload execution completed.

samples.identification: Snowflake-managed PostgreSQL escalation/RCE proof of concept
evidence: The module opens a psycopg connection and submits five SQL batches, verified with a stub connection.

Grants broad data roles, changes cron.job.username to postgres, and supplies a job command creating a SECURITY DEFINER function that executes its caller-supplied SQL. It grants that function to the initial role.

Attempts to grant snowflake_superuser, rebind pg_read_file and lo_export through LANGUAGE internal, read /etc/passwd, and export an archive_command setting over postgresql.auto.conf. Reload and WAL switch attempt to activate an id redirection as the database OS account.
These are explicit privilege-boundary bypass and backdoor attempts. No source-to-network exfiltration or stolen credential behavior exists.

Success is not established: jobid=1 is assumed, the code never waits for the scheduled function to exist, RETURN QUERY is unsuitable for the GRANT result, and archiving must already be active. The first exception stops subsequent statements.
A mutex plus ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS guard implements single-instance behavior.
Three command-line values select SelfDeleteADS and then return, so that invocation does not create the scheduled task.
SelfDeleteADS reads its own executable path, opens it for deletion, requests an ADS rename, reopens the pathname and requests delete disposition. Each failed API returns false.

FILE_RENAME_INFO has only its fixed allocation while memcpy copies a longer stream name into its trailing filename. This source has a buffer/size defect; successful rename/deletion is not demonstrated.
The ordinary main path uses system to create a user-logon task for upgrade-now.exe --runtimechk. The runtime-check branch is empty.
The AOMEI product typo is an unused local string, not PE metadata or an actual user-facing deception.

No WinHTTP, network call, archive parser, embedded payload, downloader or staged-payload deployment code is present. Published CROSSROAD identifiers support marker association, not those absent behaviors or this stub being the operational malware.

decoded_content: cleave facts reviewed for all samples; no encoded payload layer or obfuscation was found. Python raw triple-quoted SQL is plaintext.
dependency_review: The Koffi import fetched pkg:npm/koffi@3.3.3 in atomscan. All hostile findings belonged to the supplied loader source, and none belonged to the fetched dependency. No dependent-package exception was added.

neutral_relocations: CommonJS export syntax -> existing metadata/lang/javascript-features observation

Removed duplicate hostile watcher and self-delete/task combinations; neither adds hostile admission
CROSSROAD marker composite -> notable marker association; removed unsupported deployment wording and behavioral ATT&CK defaults
Removed redundant file-read observations whose exclusions did not establish their non-manifest/install-diagnostics descriptions
PostgreSQL cron escalation consolidated in exploit/database; archiver overwrite consolidated in exploit/service-command-injection
Normal backup export is a near miss: require identity-probe or admitted escalation context for hostile archiver rule
taxonomy_changes.scope_and_consumers: Every YAML exact-ID consumer was updated for moved IDs. No ancestor-only selectors targeted the moved native-copy population; leaf rule placement retained. Matching changes (literal-only memory reference, bin-path suffix anchoring, CommonJS whitespace tolerance, explicit deletion request and stronger SQL admission) are intentional and separately exercised.

tests: Eight new source capability/exploit boundary cases passed. The existing PostgreSQL catalog exercises three exploit variants and six benign controls; its stale database-URL trait expectation was updated to the current canonical ID.
